long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride past an illustrated Kansas City at golden hour: the Liberty Memorial tower on its green hill, art-deco towers glowing in the low sun, red-brick warehouses and leafy parks under a soft lavender sky, set to mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.summary: The Kansas City skyline glowing at golden hour past the train window, with mellow lofi beats.

short_2.summary: Art-deco towers and red-brick warehouses drifting by in warm evening light, with mellow lofi beats.
